# Native Office font preferences

The twelve family groups in `groups.json` are selected from the public MPL-2.0 [preferred TypeScript source](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-libreoffice-kit/blob/b19bb73c74ed893b8a5d1716d32df32a113ed31b/packages/entry/src/options.ts), lines 6–26. `PREFERRED-OPTIONS.ts.txt` retains that complete original body; LICENSE and NOTICE retain the supplier terms. No compiled entry code or private repository is selected. The JSON is a data-only adaptation for the authored Linux sandbox. Fontconfig gives exact installed families priority, then these ordered aliases, then its full bounded catalog for missing glyphs. Custom groups replace these defaults. This source availability does not qualify native dependencies/fonts or the existing pinned npm entry/Wasm gate.
